text.p: Following are some of the main stories in Dutch newspapers today. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
HET FINANCIEELE DAGBLAD
- ABN Amro bank makes friendly bid of $ 2 bn for U.S. Standard Federal Bancorp. (p1)
- Publisher De Telegraaf buys one of the Netherlands' last independent newspapers De Gooi- en Eemlander. (p1)
- Technical wholesaler Otra issues third profit warning this year; 1996 net will be markedly under last year's. (p1)
- Fund managers are not very keen on selecting Endemol Entertainment for their portfolios. (p1)
- Economic affairs minister Hans Wijers sees task for coalition in revitalising the dialogue between politics and businesses concerning emerging markets. (p1)
- Dredger Boskalis' U.K. unit Westminster places 160 million guilder order for a jumbo hopper suction dredger. (p3)
- Cable operator Casema buys The Hague's cable network from local authorities for 311 million guilders. (p3)
- Dutch industry books sharp growth in foreign orders in October. (p5)
DE VOLKSKRANT
- Rail unions call off strikes after agreement reached with Dutch Rail NS on flexible duty roster onFriday night. (p1)
- The Netherlands and Aruba look set to reach agreement on replacing police and justice chiefs on the island (p1).
- Retailer Ahold's food plant Marvelo to restructure its production. (p2)
- Christian Democrat senators split on excise hike on tobacco. (p3)
DE TELEGRAAF
- Large majority of Dutch supermarkets want longer Sunday opening hours. (p4)
- KLM, government and financial institutions discuss new ownership structure for the airline. (p15)
- FNV trades union federation urges Dutch government to take tough line on labour standards in WTO talks. (p15)
TROUW
- Greenpeace ship Sirius fails to block unloading of ship with genetically modified soy in Amsterdam port. (p3)
- Ethical savings bank ASN mulls whether to keep Ahold in portfolio in light of its presence in China and Indonesia. (p6)
ALGEMEEN DAGBLAD
- Sporadic violence in Rotterdam before and after Feyenoord-Ajax Amsterdam soccer match. (p1)
